landing.badge: Multi-tenant review pages for local businesses
landing.headline: Boost Your Google Reviews Automatically
landing.description: Give every cafe, salon, clinic, gym, or hotel its own smart review page. Happy customers go to Google, unhappy customers go private on WhatsApp.
landing.supportTitle: One SaaS, many businesses, clean /r links for every location.
landing.supportBody: Each business gets a unique review page, direct QR destination, and a lightweight dashboard. Pro unlocks deeper nudges and richer prompts.
landing.featureOneBody: Create direct links like /r/cafe-xyz or /r/salon-abc and turn them into printable QR codes instantly.
landing.featureTwoBody: Pro businesses show tailored review suggestions and a photo booster so the flow feels more premium and guided.
landing.featureThreeBody: Basic stays fast and direct. Pro adds more perceived value without needing a second codebase.
landing.detailTitle: Three simple steps from scan to social proof
landing.stepOneBody: Add the business name, choose the type, and the app generates a clean review slug automatically.
landing.stepTwoBody: Customers land directly on /r/[slug], making the flow simple, fast, and mobile-friendly.
landing.stepThreeBody: Positive visitors go to Google, private feedback goes to WhatsApp, and Pro businesses unlock richer prompts before Google.
landing.finalTitle: Launch each client page in under a minute.
landing.finalBody: Start with cafes, salons, clinics, gyms, or hotels and keep the whole product lightweight enough to deploy fast.
